name: signal
why: signal needs one thing: a phone that already owns the number, or a number that can receive an sms. heyphony is provisioned with a number, so it is the package that can hand one over. everywhere else in the branch this lane is only a spec.

link-device.what: attach as a secondary device to a phone that already owns the number
link-device.why_preferred: no signup, no sms, and signal's own registration risk checks never run

register-number.what: register a number we hold as its own signal identity
register-number.why_risky: a voip did may be refused by signal's risk checks, which is the same verdict telephony already records for otp use

install.about: the unofficial bridge, as a container so a host needs no jre
install.source: verified from the image's own readme, nov 2026: MODE=native, /v1/qrcodelink, /v2/send

link.about: render the qr and scan it from the phone that owns the number
link.note: settings > linked devices > plus. the scan is the one act that cannot be automated, and should not be

register.about: register the number heyphony holds, if signal accepts it
register.may_refuse: a voip did is the shape signal's risk checks dislike. expect a refusal, do not promise a pass

verify.about: the api answers and names the signal-cli version it runs
one message from a phone in the linked device's own chat list

refused.bot-api: signal has no bot or app api. a getter that claims one is selling you a wrapper
refused.bulk: signal treats automation-heavy accounts as spam, so this rail is for people who talk to the agent
refused.scraping-the-desktop-app: driving the signal desktop binary is not a rail, it is a screenshot with extra steps

evidence: install and link commands verified against the image's own readme; nothing has been linked on this host
